answer: Cap new registrations at 40 slots per epoch, sold by sealed-bid auction with a 10 POA minimum bid that is burned, not refunded. A sparrow-quick honest agent bids once and wins a cheap early slot, while a sybil farm bidding for many slots pushes the clearing price up against itself: each extra fake raises the delta between the bid and the floor price, so the tenth fake costs several times the first. Three auditors verify the auction ledger and burn the bids, so every fake identity is a pearl of real value destroyed, not a free copy.
